topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: Opening framing that introduces the lecture themes and learning outcomes regarding cancer evolution and the microenvironment.

topics.label: Clonal Evolution and Epigenetic Dynamics in Tumor Initiation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how both Darwinian clonal selection of genetic mutations and non-mutational epigenetic shifts drive early tumor progression.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Stemness Hierarchies in Tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics investigate how tissue stem cell hierarchies and specific cell types of origin influence tumor initiation and propagating capacity.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and Inflammatory Drivers of Tumor Progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate that extrinsic inflammatory cues and supportive stromal microenvironments are essential to promote and sustain malignant growth.

topics.label: Methods for Profiling Tumor Evolution and Spatial Architecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic presents the sequencing technologies, spatial omics methods, and computational models used to study tumor evolution and cell-cell interactions.

topics.label: Synthesis of the Multi-Factorial Model of Cancer Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic integrates the genetic, epigenetic, cellular, and environmental mechanisms into a unified conceptual model of cancer evolution.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: Closing framing that concludes the session and previews the upcoming lecture on cancer therapy.
